assessments.reasoning:
member_to_member_relationships is FALSE because relationships are recorded relative to the household head (P203) or head of the family nucleus (P203-B), without triangular matrix grids or individual pointer variables (such as mother's ID or partner's ID).

extended_ties is TRUE because P203 provides distinct codes for relations beyond spouse and parent-child, including grandchildren (Nieto/a), siblings (Hermano/a), parents/parents-in-law (Padres/Suegros), domestic workers (Trabaj. Hogar), boarders (Pensionista), and other non-relatives (Otros No Parientes).

multiple_household_criteria is TRUE because Pregunta 10 of ENAHO.01 explicitly defines the criterion for separating multiple households within a dwelling as individuals who share meals from the same pot ("se alimentan de una misma olla") and attend to basic needs in common.

sub_units is TRUE because Preguntas 203-A and 203-B assign each household member a family nucleus number ("N° DE NÚCLEO FAMILIAR") and record their relationship to the head of that nucleus, identifying sub-units within the household.

caregiving_relationships is FALSE because while the instrument records general household chores or minor activities (e.g., P211A), it does not record who provides care to whom within or across households.
